mod_hidden_desc: Shows hidden tanks in the research tree.
mod_autoranks_desc: Removes rank gating from the hangar UI.
mod_random_tank_desc: Random-tank dice button for the hangar. WoT Blitz only.
mod_server_select_desc: Server list instead of the map, cluster picker. WoT Blitz only.
help_hidden_body:
SUPPORTED PROJECTS:
• WoT Blitz and Tanks Blitz.
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
• Shows all hidden tanks in the research tree: premium, collectible, test and deprecated vehicles become visible in their branches. Purchase still depends on the developers' offers.
CHANGED FILES:
• WoT Blitz: Configs/TechTree/*_tree.yaml — 9 files (one per nation); XML/item_defs/vehicles/*/list.xml — 9 files. Total: 18 files.
• Tanks Blitz: same 18 files.
HOW IT CHANGES FILES:
• WoT Blitz: in list.xml sets notInShop=false and cleans the hiding tags; in *_tree.yaml appends hidden tanks with new position entries (ordinary, then collectible, then premium). Adds the unified header stamp.
• Tanks Blitz: same changes.
IMPACT:
• Research tree and vehicle lists only. No balance, prices or account progress. If packs has a micro-update with new tanks, enable DLC mode.
help_autoranks_body:
SUPPORTED PROJECTS:
• WoT Blitz and Tanks Blitz.
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
• Disables rank gating in the hangar UI: the Battle button is always visible, unlock hints are hidden, auto rank-up is removed. Ranks are taken manually by button.
CHANGED FILES:
• WoT Blitz: Hangar.yaml, SquadView.yaml, Inventory.yaml, AchievementsTab.yaml. Total: 4 files.
• Tanks Blitz: same 4 files plus AchievementsTab.actions, 2 rank init animations and 2 rank popups. Total: 9 files.
HOW IT CHANGES FILES:
• WoT Blitz: flips the ranksAvailable and needsUnlock master switches off, cuts rankUnlockRequired conditions and UnlockRank events. Adds the unified header stamp.
• Tanks Blitz: same switches, plus auto UnlockFirstRank calls cut out of both init animations, ceremony fanfares cut, TankRankAvailable/TankRanksUnlocked popups hidden. Manual acquisition by button, like on WoT Blitz. Adds the unified header stamp.
IMPACT:
• Lobby and hangar visuals only. No research tree, balance or account progress.
help_random_tank_body:
SUPPORTED PROJECTS:
• WoT Blitz only. Tanks Blitz ships the official random picker in the tank filter, so the mod is unavailable there.
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
• Adds a two-dice button to the hangar tanks panel — pressing it selects a random owned tank.
CHANGED FILES:
• WoT Blitz: TanksPanel.yaml and TanksPanel.actions changed; dice icon plus @2x added as new files. Total: 3 files.
• Tanks Blitz: unavailable.
HOW IT CHANGES FILES:
• WoT Blitz: inserts the button before the filter panel and the pick action with carousel scroll; the dice icon is generated on every run. Adds the unified header stamp.
• Tanks Blitz: unavailable.
IMPACT:
• Hangar tanks panel and the new icon only. Restoring the original removes the added icon.

help_server_select_body:
SUPPORTED PROJECTS:
• WoT Blitz only. Tanks Blitz has no server selection screen at the app level.
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
• Pins the server list instead of the map; clusters sit under their own server as name + suffix rows. Login screens show the name with cluster too. Search accepts every language; regions are numbered, order is identical everywhere.
CHANGED FILES:
• WoT Blitz: ServerSelection.yaml, ServerDescriptionPrototype.yaml, Entry.yaml, NewGame.yaml, regions in Data plus the region_cache. Total: 9 files.
• Tanks Blitz: unavailable.
HOW IT CHANGES FILES:
• WoT Blitz: toggle hidden, list forced, search opened; cluster second line; name with suffix; numbered region copies. The client reads regions from the region_cache (picked by Data/version) — the mod patches the cache and marks it read-only so the game cannot rebuild it; regions_publish.yaml twins in Data are patched as the source. Adds the unified header stamp.
• Tanks Blitz: unavailable.
IMPACT:
• Login screen only. Changing region means a different account/progress; changing cluster inside a region keeps progress. Re-select the server once after generating. Close the game before generating; if an update wipes clusters, regenerate.

mod_tank_stats_desc: Damage, battles and win rate in the carousel + mastery badge at the level.
help_tankstats_body:
SUPPORTED PROJECTS:
• WoT Blitz and Tanks Blitz.
WHAT THE MOD DOES:
• Adds a compact stats column to every tank cell in the hangar carousel: average damage, battle count and win rate. Plus the highest earned mastery badge (Master > 1st > 2nd > 3rd class) right of the level badge.
CHANGED FILES:
• WoT Blitz: OwnedTankCell.yaml. Total: 1 file.
• Tanks Blitz: OwnedTankCell.yaml. Total: 1 file.
HOW IT CHANGES FILES:
• WoT Blitz: inserts the StatisticsHolder column before TankInfo (dossier values, win-rate colors 45/50/60/70) and the MasteryBadge after VehicleInfo (30px, offsets tuned for tiers I–X). Adds the unified header stamp.
• Tanks Blitz: inserts the TankStats column before the inner TankInfo and the MasteryBadge before the column (26px, own offsets). Adds the unified header stamp.
IMPACT:
• Carousel cells only. No balance, dossiers or account progress.
